subject: Problems with SleepLog not being used

messages.author: 8a111421fc88de0c
messages.subject: Problems with SleepLog not being used
parts:
Hello, 

We are currently trying to get GGIR to use a sleep log. The script reads in the sleep log but has not been using it when we check in the QC folder. Please see the Script Below

library(GGIR)


GGIR(
  mode=c(1,2,3,4,5),
  datadir="//acct.upmchs.net/oac/scneuro/GENEActiv/LEAP/bin_data/GGIR_Log_Test1",
  #setwd(datadir),
  outputdir="//acct.upmchs.net/oac/scneuro/GENEActiv/GGIR/GGIR_TESTS/TEST_GGIR_GoodLog_2022-10-21",
  do.report=c(2,4,5),
 
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  hrs.del.start = 0,          hrs.del.end = 0,
  maxdur = 9,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  mvpathreshold =c(100),
  bout.metric = 6,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  #HDCZA is the default guider if no sleep log is passed
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #Sleep log stuff
  # guider = "sleep log",
  loglocation = c("//acct.upmchs.net/oac/scneuro/GENEActiv/LEAP/bin_data/GGIR_Log_Test1/Good_Test_Log.csv"),
  colid = 1,
  coln1 = 2,
  nnights = 7,
  sleeplogsep = ",",
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  save_ms5rawlevels=TRUE,
  save_ms5raw_format="csv",
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Problems with SleepLog not being used
parts:
Hi Lauren,

This indicates that the sleep log was either not in the correct format or the nights in the sleeplog did not overlap with valid parts of the accelerometer recording. 

Without a clear description of your sleeplog it is hard to provide feedback. Can you share an example of your sleeplog, e.g. with any participant identifiable info removed?

Thanks, Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
